transcript:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2119993333 — smart-routing.policy errors detected in prod. auto-paging eng-sre. link: https://internal.redwood/incs/2119993333
Priya: ack — I'm taking triage. paging runtime and platform. @Carlos @Jamie
Mike: oncall here, pulling logs now. what customers are impacted?
Anya: support seeing tickets from 3 EU customers (prod orgs) — elevated 5xxs and timeouts starting ~10:45 UTC. no PII reported. customers reporting request latencies 2–5s and occasional 502/503.
Carlos: logs show repeated route-rejects in eu-west-1: policy engine rejects model variant -> triggers cross-region fallback to us-central1 -> subsequent checks think eu-west regained capacity -> fallback back to eu-west -> oscillation. spike in route-change events roughly every 30s.
Carlos: stack traces point at policy-validator: it's accepting a deprecated field and falling back to an unintended default behavior. digging config snapshots.
Priya: quick find: during yesterday's schema migration we removed the legacy field "preferred_variant" from the canonical policy schema. the validator code path didn't error on presence of the deprecated field and instead set use_default=true which maps to the old "closest-with-variant" routing behavior.
Priya: short config example from redis snapshot:
```
routing_policy: {
  "policy_id": "smart-routing",
  "preferred_variant": "redwood/small-quant",  # deprecated field (should be rejected)
  "fallback_regions": ["eu-west-1","us-central1"],
  "allow_cross_region_fallback": true
}
```
Priya: validator should have rejected preferred_variant and forced an explicit modern mapping, but it silently let it through and the runtime interpreted it as "choose closest available variant" which here cycles because the variant isn't present in eu-west.
Mike: mitigation plan — immediate steps:
- pin routing for smart-routing in eu-west-1 to a known-good variant
- temporarily disable cross-region fallback for smart-routing to stop oscillation
- roll out fix to validator in next patch
I'll take the first two now.
Jamie: applying override via controlplane now:
```
# pin variant in eu-west
redwoodctl route lock --policy smart-routing --region eu-west-1 --variant redwood/medium-stable
# disable cross-region fallback
redwoodctl route update --policy smart-routing --allow_cross_region_fallback false
```
Jamie: hooks executed, changes pushed to control plane. waiting for propagation (30s).
Carlos: seeing immediate drop in route-change churn. 503s in eu-west-1 dropping from 6.2% -> 0.5% within 3m. latency back to normal for affected customers.
Anya: customers notified with interim update. they're seeing requests recover. marking as "service restored" in support tracker.
Priya: root cause summary for notes: schema migration removed deprecated field but validator logic didn't treat presence of deprecated field as invalid. parser path fell back to legacy default behavior (closest-region-with-variant) which, combined with uneven variant deployments, produced failover oscillation.
Priya: proposed remediation (short/med/long):
- short: keep the route pin and disabled fallback until rollout completes (done)
- med: push validator patch to reject deprecated fields and fail-fast on unknown keys; add hotfix to reject present deprecated fields during parse
- long: add integration test that runs policy schema validations against a canon set of example policies; extend canary to include cross-region fallback churn detection
Carlos: quick repro command used:
```
curl -XPOST https://api.internal.redwood/policies/_validate -d '{"preferred_variant":"redwood/small-quant"}'
# current validator returns 200 OK (incorrect)
```
Carlos: fix is a 2-line guard in validator. I'll open PR now and attach tests. assign to eng-ml for review since this touches policy semantics.
Jamie: operational follow-ups:
- add alert for repeated route-flip > 5 flips in 5m per policy
- add dashboard widget for variant coverage per region
- schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC
Lina: customer-ops will prepare proactive customer email and credit offer. draft ready; will share in #customer-ops for review. also tracking impacted customer UUIDs.
Mike: handoff: I'm out in 45m. Priya — can you take on-call after that and own rollback/validator patch until fixed? I'll leave the pinned route and a runbook note: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/smart-routing-oscillation
Priya: yep I'll take handoff. I'll also coordinate postmortem writeup and add remediation owners. assigning validators PR to Carlos, tests to Jamie, canary work to eng-sre.
Anya: closing support tickets for now, will reopen if customers re-escalate. posting summary to affected customers in 1h.
incident-bot: Pager cleared by Mike — incident set to "mitigated" at 2119995133. Please follow postmortem process and tag incident-runbook. :white_check_mark:
Mike: TL;DR for postmortem: schema migration tolerated deprecated fields => silent legacy-default behavior -> variant not present in region -> cross-region fallback oscillation -> customer-facing 503s. Fixes: validator reject deprecated fields, add tests/alerts, pin rollout until validator enforces schema. I'll draft the postmortem after handoff.
Priya: adding action items to tracking board now. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
